body:
Closed both remaining gaps from the prior loop-binding-value-shaped entry: if-value-shaped? widened into every-call-arg-symbol-or-number?/emit-call-arg (closing a previously-silent empty 'return ;'), and emit-tail-symbol's bare true/false literal now correctly boxed via emit-tail-expr/emit-i32-boxed after a real, live-found -Werror=int-conversion bug (return 1; from a char*-declared function) was caught by direct minimal gcc compilation, not just the self-compile diagnostic's no-#error bar. 4 new dedicated tests (compile+run+assert), stdlib/string.prn's is-valid-i32-text? now compiles fully correct end to end. make test: 347/347.

⚓ ☃
title: selfhost/emit: if-as-comparison-operand + tail true/false literal fixed, real int-conversion bug caught
